body.statement: For every feasible \((H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)\), \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)\) terminates after at most \(B_\star(n,L,\gamma)\) state transitions and exactly one outcome holds: \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\) with \(F(P_M)=\theta_M(y;x)\) for every \(M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\), where \(F\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) is evaluated on cylinders of \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), or \(\operatorname{FAIL}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{lag}}(\mathcal A))\) encoding \(M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\) with \(P_{M_0}=P_{M_1}\) as measures on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\) and \(\theta_{M_0}(y;x)\ne\theta_{M_1}(y;x)\). Moreover, \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\iff\operatorname{UID}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)=1\).
body.justification: The dichotomy is the first sound-and-complete graph-native decision theorem for lag-specific micro effects under latent-confounded summary uncertainty.
body.gap: Assaad, Devijver, Gaussier, Gössler, and Meynaoui give causally sufficient SCG total-effect adjustment conditions; Ferreira--Assaad give completeness for linear direct effects under causal sufficiency; Assaad gives latent-confounded front-door sufficiency; and Ferreira--Assaad separately give macro do-calculus completeness. None covers a nonparametric lag-specific micro total effect under hidden confounding. Jahn--Karnik--Schulman decide one fully specified periodic graph, Jaber and coauthors decide a PAG class on a fixed finite vertex set, and Shpitser--Pearl decide one fixed ADMG rather than an exact-summary stationary refinement class.
body.consumer: EasyRCA can attach a causal transmission score only to successful lag queries and can display a concrete certificate when it must abstain.

obligation.what_is_open: Construction and proof of termination, accepting soundness, rejecting soundness, and completeness of \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}\).
obligation.obstruction: The procedure and bound are supplied only by the unresolved open-ended normal-form target. Without an accepting invariant a \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}\) token has no proved causal meaning; without a general fixed-alphabet collision lift a \(\operatorname{FAIL}\) token has no certified pair of compatible stationary SCMs.
obligation.attempted: I derived the formal consequences that would follow from the two branch invariants and checked the explicit lag-switch rejection witness, but neither step constructs the missing normal form or proves its completeness.
obligation.partial_result: Conditional on a normal form having the advertised accepting and rejecting invariants, accepting soundness would follow from its typed cylinder identity and rejecting soundness from a valid fixed-alphabet stationary lift; exclusivity would then follow directly from \(\mathrm{def:uniform\text{-}identification}\).  The lag-switch proposition supplies one concrete mandatory rejection.  The missing normal form prevents an unconditional termination bound and completeness implication.
